text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Page: HIGH 5xx spike - gateway-service (eu-west-1) - 5m sustained error rate > 6% (alerts: gateway.5xx_rate)
sara: ack, I'm on it. pulling logs + checking dashboards. tagging @jay for infra
jay: seeing a big jump in 502/504 from gateway -> model-router pool, ~03:06 UTC. connection reset errors and > 95% of failures attributed to tenant: partner-alpha
lee: confirmed. model-router is fanouting requests to reranker replicas. the partner has a sudden batch of long prompts causing heavy KV-cache pressure and many concurrent streams.
miguel: any recent deploys to model-router or reranker? logs show an increase in connection attempts from gateway to reranker around 03:04
sara: deploy-bot shows no deploys in the last hour to those services. looks like traffic pattern change, not code.
amanda: can we rate-limit partner-alpha at the gateway while we triage? can do a quick config change in the routing layer.
jay: yes. creating an emergency route policy to cap concurrency to 6 for partner-alpha and enable short backpressure. running:

```bash
# apply temporary rate limit
redwoodctl routing set-policy --tenant partner-alpha --concurrency 6 --burst 2 --region eu-west-1
```
oncall-bot: action executed by jay at 03:12 UTC
sara: traffic dropped and 5xx rate is back under 1.5% in the last 2 mins. good mitigation. :white_check_mark:
lee: while rate-limit helps, the root stress seems to be the reranker spawning many upstream calls for long contexts. we should limit reranker fanout in model-router to 4 per request as a short-term fix.
miguel: on it. opening hotfix PR to add a cap and degrade to truncated-context mode for oversized prompts. PR: https://scm.redwood/models/PR-4523
amanda: I'll notify CS and affected customers. @cs-team please prepare comms for partner-alpha.
cs-team: on it. drafting a note and outreach plan. marking impact: partial degraded responses for partner-alpha from 03:06–03:15 UTC. no data exfiltration. customers affected: partner-alpha (tier: enterprise)
jay: also scaling reranker pool by +3 replicas as temporary capacity boost:

```bash
kubectl -n prod-eu scale deployment reranker --replicas=8
```
deploy-bot: scale rollout started (deployment/reranker) at 03:13 UTC
lee: collect flamegraphs and KV cache metrics for postmortem. capturing heap + file descriptors on two reranker pods: reranker-7 and reranker-9
sara: handing incident to @amanda for follow-up and post-incident items. I'm stepping out at 03:15 UTC. checklist left:
- ensure hotfix PR merges and deploys
- keep rate-limit policy until PR is live
- update runbook with partner-rate-limit step
- adjust alerts to fire on sustained fanout rather than short bursts
amanda: taking over. thanks @sara. current status: mitigated (rate-limit + reranker scaling + hotfix PR). next: validate hotfix, merge, and run smoke tests.
miguel: hotfix PR submitted, requesting expedited review. patch changes:
- add fanout cap (4)
- fallback to truncated-context mode when context tokens > 8192
- connection pool backoff tuned to 200ms base
amanda: after hotfix lands, we will remove temporary routing cap in 30m if graphs look stable. also creating an incident-ticket with action items.
oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1912345678 (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-1912345678)
amanda: immediate post-incident action items (assigning):
- miguel: merge hotfix PR + monitor canary (due 1h)
- jay: runbook update to include tenant-rate-limiter steps + sample `redwoodctl` commands (due EOD)
- lee: add KV-cache and fanout metrics to gateway dashboard + tweak alert sensitivity (due EOD)
- cs-team: send customer impact note to partner-alpha and offer degraded-mode support (due 2h)
- sara: add postmortem doc skeleton and chair the blameless RCA (due tomorrow)
cs-team: sent initial customer note at 03:22 UTC. partner-alpha acknowledged, asked for postmortem. :eyes:
miguel: hotfix merged and canary deployed at 03:34 UTC. canary running against 10% traffic to reranker. preliminary results: no 5xx from canary group.
amanda: removing temporary rate-limit for partner-alpha now (will leave for 30m if metrics remain green).
jay: rate-limit removed at 03:40 UTC
sara: final check: 5xx steady ~0.4% for last 10 mins. marking incident as mitigated and moving to post-incident review. grateful for the quick coordination. :thumbsup:
amanda: filing runbook PR to include a new section: "partner-induced fanout - emergency steps" with commands and thresholds. linking incident ticket.
oncall-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> POSTMORTEM_REQUIRED. owners: sara (RCA lead), miguel (hotfix), jay (infra runbook), lee (metrics).
